plans.note: No liability/limitation section appears in the supplied outline; only the title, two operative provisions (1.4, 5.4) and the signature block are visible. If a fuller text exists, check the general/miscellaneous provisions; otherwise flag as a gap requiring a mutual cap with carve-outs (IP, confidentiality, indemnity, willful misconduct).

Missing-type rule: no indemnity section surfaced. Expect to insert HDI indemnity for third-party IP infringement arising from the developed/hosted site and for HDI's own misconduct, keeping our indemnity narrow to content we supply.

Presence check: no covenant-not-to-compete visible. Section 1.4 concerns HDI granting us access, not restricting us, but review it and any product/channel provisions for implied limits on selling Deerskin Products through other sites.

Presence check: no exclusivity clause in the outline. Site development/hosting deals often make HDI the sole provider — scan Section 1.4 and any scope-of-services text for sole-source or exclusive-hosting language binding us.
Direction check: no pricing or MFN provision appears. If fee terms surface, confirm no obligation runs from us to HDI to grant best terms; an MFN in our favour is acceptable.

Presence check: Section 5.4 (each party appoints a representative) is the only personnel-related provision and is the most likely home for any no-hire/no-solicit of the other party's project staff; otherwise absent.

No term/termination section is exposed, though 'Termination Date' is a defined term — locate the defining provision and confirm we hold a convenience-termination right on notice without penalty and HDI does not.
No renewal mechanics visible; tied to the 'Termination Date' definition. Check for auto-renewal, notice window and price-escalation caps in the term provisions if they appear.

No governing-law/venue clause in the outline; such boilerplate typically sits immediately before the signature block (sec-p0072). Verify law is NY/DE/CA/E&W with courts rather than foreign arbitration.

No assignment/change-of-control provision surfaced; look in the miscellaneous block near the signature page. Given HDI is an affiliate-type counterparty, confirm we may assign to affiliates/successors and HDI cannot terminate on our change of control.

Section 1.4 grants us access to (presumably) the site/systems and touches Deerskin Products content — primary place to test ownership direction: we must own the site deliverables we pay for and all Deerskin/customer data, with no assignment of our IP or data to HDI.
Section 1.4 is the access/licence-style grant; check scope extends to our affiliates and contractors, is irrevocable for the term, and is not conditioned on HDI's discretion.

No audit or inspection right against us appears; if one is embedded in the access provisions (1.4) or representative/reporting mechanics (5.4), require notice, annual frequency, off-site review and HDI's cost.
Direction check: no liquidated damages, penalty or service-level credit provision visible. Confirm any credits run to us and that no penalty is payable by us for missed milestones or volumes.

No warranty section in the outline. Development/hosting work needs a workmanlike performance and availability warranty with repair/re-perform or refund; check for a hidden disclaimer near the service provisions (1.4).
Missing-type rule: no insurance covenant appears. HDI hosts our site and handles our data, so propose standard commercial general liability, tech E&O/cyber and evidence-of-coverage obligations.
Presence check: no fee schedule or minimum volume/take-or-pay language surfaced. If hosting fees or minimum order commitments appear elsewhere, ensure an exit or true-up relief.

Missing-type rule: nothing addresses post-termination wind-down despite the defined 'Termination Date'. Add return of our data in usable format, migration assistance for a defined tail period, and deletion certification.
